value: 2026-09-06 (ticket 3feb201c84ea, one status everywhere): owning_intention 'cairn/cairn/machines/build_inspector/intention+why.json' resolved under neither root; stripped the extra 'cairn/' — the one reader surfaced it; data repair, no design change.

value.a: PERSISTENCE IS THE SUBSTRATE, COMPARISON IS THE GOAL. A persisted record nothing compares is a bigger version of the current defect: data accumulating while the question goes unasked. This is why the ticket is not done when records land on disk, and why persistence is not split off as a child — a child that can pass while embodying the parent's failure is a decomposition that makes the work worse.

A RECORD OF FAILURES CANNOT SUPPORT ANY OF THIS. Green must be recorded, because the disease is the inability to tell a green from an absence. Same shape as the answer the monitoring field converged on independently: NO DATA is a third state, configured separately, never a variant of pass or fail.

THE MANAGER SMELL IS REAL AND THE DEFENCE HAS TO BE SPECIFIC. A corpus-wide record of every check run is exactly the central collection CC builds the moment something exists in plural, and the honest test is who needs to see them ALL. The answer here is a named singular consumer — the corrosion review — and a question that genuinely spans components: 'has this check ever redded' cannot be computed per component.

SCOPE DECISION MADE VISIBLE RATHER THAN DEFAULTED: a shared format with build_inspector as first tenant, not one component's private log. Five private logs cannot answer the corpus-spanning question, which is the only reason the record exists.
